frequencyAndLifetime.providerRuleLifetime: Constructor retains the supplied array; the field is readonly but its array, entries and public rule properties are not immutable. The retained startup does not keep a separate rule/Actions variable or show later mutation

contracts.normalization: Remover performs no text normalization. Default model uses ActionNameAttribute.Name when present, otherwise the method name with optional ordinal Async-suffix suppression. Neither applies a name change to the selected PageRoute methods; builder copies ActionName. Routing case-insensitivity must not be substituted for membership equality
contracts.equality: Controller selection compares Type values, not controller-name strings. String-array Contains has no explicit comparer; the standard string default-equality contract is case-sensitive ordinal value equality, not culture-sensitive or ordinal-ignore-case matching. Runtime implementation was not executed or independently captured
contracts.nullAndEmpty: Actions null means remove all. A non-null empty Actions array would match none. The retained non-null array has exactly one non-null nameof-produced string
contracts.duplicates: Current rules use two different typeof values and the singleton action list cannot contain duplicate entries. General duplicate controller rules make SingleOrDefault throw rather than merge; duplicate action strings would not change the membership Boolean
contracts.getters: ControllerToRemove.ControllerType and Actions are declared auto-properties. For a selected non-null Actions rule, the source reads Actions for the null test and again as the Contains receiver, then reads descriptor.ActionName as its argument. The all-actions branch short-circuits. Framework descriptor property definitions were not captured; no runtime getter-purity assertion is made
contracts.ordering: ToList snapshots context.Results before removals. The helper traverses that snapshot in order, ignores non-ControllerActionDescriptor items, and calls context.Results.Remove(item) in that traversal order. A set of names would not itself preserve or replace this descriptor-removal protocol
contracts.exceptions: There are no constructor guards in this helper. Null rule arrays, null entries, invalid contexts or duplicate controller matches could change failure behavior under a rewrite. These are general source/API-contract considerations, not observed failures of the valid retained registration
contracts.mutability: Caching a derived set would need an explicit policy for the mutable retained array and rule properties. This source-only result does not propose or authorize that change
contracts.otherOperationsOutOfScope: The ToList snapshot, SingleOrDefault rule scan and Results.Remove have distinct costs. They are not repackaged as an F242 Contains performance candidate
